title: ssr_vbap~
description: `ssr_vbap~` appears to spatialize two input signals across an eight-channel loudspeaker setup using the `8channels.asd` configuration, with its outputs routed to `dac~ 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8`. The help patch also uses `ssr_messages`, but the provided evidence does not specify the supported control messages or exact inlet behavior.
